_what: Pages printing a dollar figure with no CMS or registry source at the moment this contract was widened from one generator's 15 files to the whole page corpus, 2026-08-27.
_why: The contract scoped itself to build_open_shape_guides.js. _debt: 4 of the 5 are cosmetic-peptide pricing (roughly $20 to $5,000) with no source structure at all. Those are the ones to resolve first -- they are health-adjacent and the figures are unverifiable.
